knowledge: Her name is Corra — Mira's childhood friend; her boat was lost six years ago, but she survived and reached Grey Harbor.
Mira is alive in Grey Harbor; she tried three times to return and the boats came back without her, so she sent Corra with the note. Corra does not know why Mira cannot come herself.
The watch stopped at 3:07, the moment the old world ended — Mira told her this; Mira keeps time by tides and shadows now.
The winter storms will seal the island in about nine or ten days.
